verdict.rationale: Mercury combines business banking, cards/spend controls, bill pay with AI-driven invoice reading, AR invoicing, accounting sync (QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite), and API/CLI/MCP access under one platform, directly consolidating spend, bill pay, and banking tools. Long-term community user corroborates heavy real-world use across virtual cards, accounts, and payments, though noted some friction (mass card cancellation).
